answer.rationale: Finance's 18% cost reduction mandate cannot be met with the incumbent vendor who has refused to reopen pricing. The low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate. Memory_c2 demonstrates a successful prior transition to a low-cost vendor with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, directly supporting this action. The contract expires in 14 days without auto-renewal, necessitating immediate, full-scale action. While switching carries transition risk at 94% line utilization with no buffer, it is the only viable path to meet the cost target; deferring or negotiating are infeasible under current constraints.
